notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
